MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

6. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

9. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   C. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing games.

10. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Damage equipment used for Dance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
